svg.title: The Runsketch effort model
svg.desc: Terrain grade sets a speed plan, the speed plan sets heart-rate demand, and fast vagal and slow sympathetic kinetics lag behind that demand to give recorded heart rate. Weather runs through a single heat balance that forks into both: a pace factor on the speed plan and a heat share folded into the heart-rate drift budget. Cadence, power, GPS error and altimeter come from the same run, and one seeded result feeds both the preview and the FIT, TCX and GPX files.
